content: Tasmin sati shvasaprashvasayor gati vichchhedah pranayamah. (When posture is steady, pranayama is the conscious regulation of the flow of inhalation and exhalation).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Tasmin sati shvasaprashvasayor gati vichchhedah pranayamah. ...) focuses directly on tasmin and sati. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on tasmin today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper tasmin and sati in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
